name: PolterDates
storyline:
Dolores Delalma, matchmaker and medium, must spend three days pairing up the several ghosts that come asking for help. Help her on her mission to make the afterlife a place full of love — or a sea of broken hearts!

Draw the pentagram, question the souls, and form spectral couples that will last until the end of time. But be careful — the candles that connect you to the dead won’t stay lit forever. ️

Choose wisely who to talk to and what to say so you can determine which soul is the perfect match for your client before time runs out.
summary: It's a short narrative game where you play as Dolores Delalma, a medium and matchmaker who has to pair souls.
